_comment: Langmuir isotherms with temperature dependence, anchored to the single points of the thesis (Tab. 2, 0.8 bar, 100 C).
q_m (saturation capacity) and dH (isosteric heat) are ESTIMATES unless listed in 'overrides':
q_m = micropore volume of the zeolite / molar volume of the liquid refrigerant at its normal boiling point
dH  = isosteric_factor * heat of vaporisation at the normal boiling point
Replace them with fitted values as soon as there are isotherms at two or more temperatures.
